approval.source: Owner authorized recommended numeric qualification limits in the issue #12 implementation conversation on 2026-10-26, then explicitly approved 32 claims per release-workload cycle while retaining the one-claim safety regression.
approval.scope: Candidate qualification thresholds; production activation and release acceptance remain separate.

receipt_retention: Retain request keys, canonical request bodies and applied-level receipts throughout the occurrence lifetime and for at least 90 days after it ends; retain coherent backups across that recovery horizon. No automatic pruning is introduced.
remaining_measurements: Exact-current-joint-stack paired 300-case qualification, including every non-throughput gate
Mixed-backlog fairness and progress under churn
Workload-scale recovery time, row writes, WAL and peak memory against the approved numeric limits
Coherent recovery across the 90-day post-occurrence receipt/key retention horizon
